title: Can I BEAT Seirawan Chess?
summary: Seirawan (S-chess): each side holds an Eagle/Hawk (knight+bishop) and an Elephant (knight+rook) in reserve; when a back-rank piece makes its first move, you may drop one of them onto the square it just left. He drops them early, wins the first three and a bonus fourth with elephant+eagle mate.
rules: Standard setup plus two reserve pieces per side: Hawk/'Eagle' (bishop+knight) and Elephant (rook+knight).
A reserve piece may only enter when a piece on the back rank moves for the first time: it is dropped onto the vacated square as part of that move.
It cannot be dropped on a square vacated by a piece that has already moved, nor behind another 'suspicious' (reserve) piece's move (8:06).
If all back-rank pieces have moved, unused reserve pieces are lost.
Castling: a reserve piece may be dropped on either the king's or rook's vacated square (standard S-chess, inferred).
Pawns may promote to Hawk or Elephant (19:02 promotes to elephant).
setup: rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR[HEhe] w KQkq - 0 1 (reserves shown in a pocket beside the board)
current_impl_issues: Current impl maps Seirawan to Crazyhouse-lite (captured pieces dropped anywhere) - wrong. Needs Hawk/Elephant reserve gating onto vacated back-rank squares.
